error[ZC-E0404]: a node's accounting disagrees with its assignments
  cause  1 of 2 nodes disagree; the first, node1, records 3 assignments and 300
         cpu millis, its assignments sum to 2 and 200
  fix    see what a repair would write   zcube repair allocations node1
